_comment: Pending / reported transfers, shown with an amber PENDING badge.
This file is edited by hand on purpose. Confirmed deals are scraped from
Wikipedia, but there is no trustworthy structured feed for rumours —
goal.com and the rest are editorial headlines, and deriving 'player X to
club Y for Z' from a headline produces wrong data that still looks
authoritative on the page. So pending deals are only ever what you put
Fields: player, fromClub, toClub, feeEurM (approximate is fine), note
(what stage it's at), source (where you read it), and status.
'denied'            — red, the clubs or player have knocked the story down
Delete a pending entry once it's confirmed — the scraper will pick it up
from Wikipedia on the next refresh and it'll turn green automatically.
